entities.summary: Out of Line Music is an independent record label located in Berlin, Germany, Miami, Florida, and Las Vegas, Nevada. Out of Line is distributed by Rough Trade and exclusive partner to publishing giant BMG Rights Management, through sister company Edition Layer Cake.
